input:
Earlier scenes:
孟子小的时候，从早到晚都跟朋友玩。孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜。孟子五岁的时候，跟妈妈搬家。他们搬家不是因为孟子玩得太多，而是因为妈妈认为他们的家离墓地太近。

This scene:
妈妈认为，住离墓地太近，害得孟子的心气。孟子和孟母搬到子思老师的家，跟子思老师住。孟母帮子思打扫房间和做饭。子思帮孟母教她的儿子。因为孟子现在没有朋友，他老是读书。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 住离墓地太近，害得孟子的心气：住在离墓地太近的地方，会害得孟子受到不好的影响，害得Sb. + V.
- 因为孟子现在没有朋友，他老是读书：孟子现在没有朋友，因为他老是读书

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 住离墓地太近：住在离墓地太近的地方，The verb pattern is “住在 + place”; the location needs “在” and a noun phrase such as “地方.”
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 害得孟子的心气：影响孟子的学习，“心气” means morale or ambition and cannot stand alone as the result after “害得” here; “影响孟子的学习” clearly states the negative effect.
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 老是：一直，“老是” usually carries a negative, complaining tone. Use “一直” for the neutral idea that he keeps studying.
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 跟子思老师住：跟他住，Use a pronoun for a close re-occurrence when the previously named person has no competing referent.
5. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟母帮子思打扫房间和做饭：孟母帮他打扫房间和做饭，Use a pronoun for a close re-occurrence of the recently mentioned person.
6. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 孟子和孟母搬到子思老师的家：孟子和孟母搬到了子思老师的家，Add “了” to mark the completed move in this narrative sequence.
7. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 孟母帮子思打扫房间和做饭：孟母帮他打扫房间和做了饭，For a completed series of actions, only the last verb takes “了.”
8. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 子思帮孟母教她的儿子：子思帮孟母教了她的儿子，Add “了” to mark the completed helping action in the sequence.
9. [Coherence: connectors, error] Coherence (Conjunction): 因为孟子现在没有朋友，：因为孟子现在没有朋友，所以，Use the paired connector “因为……所以……” to show the cause-and-effect relation.

items.reason: 住 needs 在 before the location, and the location needs a noun phrase such as 地方.
害得 must be followed by a person and a harmful result clause, and 孟子的心气 is not a suitable result here.
老是 can be used here and is not an error merely because it may carry a mildly negative tone.
子思老师 was just mentioned and 他 clearly refers to him, so the repeated full name should be replaced by a pronoun.
子思 was mentioned immediately before, so 他 is the appropriate close re-reference.
The move is a completed narrative event, so 搬到 should take 了 as 搬到了.
For the completed action series, the final verb should take 了: 打扫房间和做了饭.
This is a completed helping action in the story sequence, so 教 should take 了.
The problem is the reversed causal relation—he has no friends because he always studies—not merely a missing 所以.
